changes: Implemented a Review Assurance Floor DONE gate for material code stories. The gate now requires fresh local host-verdict evidence, escalates repaired failure-signal stories to sticky 3x1, requires high-risk lifecycle/gate/Authority/process-fact material work to satisfy 3x2 or explicit degraded 3x1 fallback, threads resolved gitCwd through DONE guard/oracle paths, and registers all gate-consumed process facts mechanically.
usage: Use normal Lattice lifecycle: after TEST validation, run review_escalation_status for diagnostics, submit local Non-authority host verdicts with autopilot_review_submit, then complete delivery_check_set, summary_set, and story_advance DONE. Authority completion still requires separate Authority Server receipt verification.
expectedOutcome: Before DONE, material high-risk stories cannot close from a single local review if first-round verified problems occurred; Lattice reports an actionable review assurance/review escalation diagnostic and accepts only fresh current-material 3x2 local host rounds or explicit degraded fallback.
actualTranscript: TEST validate passed: npm --prefix packages/main run build, authority-client smoke, and authority-completion smoke all passed; verification coverage was 12/12. REVIEW lanes concept, quality, and test-coverage passed after F-001 through F-004 were resolved. review_escalation_status reports ok=true, assuranceLevel=full-3x2, authorityDone=false, fullAuthorityDone=false, productionDone=false.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible behavior gap for the requested local Non-authority assurance floor. Remaining Authority Server receipt-backed completion is intentionally separate and not claimed by this story.
limitations: No Authority Server production completion is claimed; this story implements and verifies local Lattice CLI Non-authority review assurance evidence only.
pitfalls: REVIEW to TEST preflight once hit the 300 second no-output guard and had to be retried. Initial host verdict submissions reused the same keyId and were correctly rejected as non-independent; the final passing 3x2 uses distinct host/session/key identities per host.
